name: AT Hub Server
description:
A Minecraft Bedrock server that brings together building, exploration, and competition within a welcoming community for everyone.

🏦 Collect Dinars and manage your wealth through the bank, transfers, and a personal vault.

🪵 Trade wood in a dynamic economy where prices shift based on supply and demand.

🤝 Form alliances with your friends and establish your place in the world.

🏆 Compete for the top spot in seasonal leaderboards and track your stats and profile on our website.

Start your adventure and build a story worth telling.

🌐 How to join: at-hub.net
